name: "The operating system is running" reads the building and not the company: a row or a statement in the assembled test that distinguishes the two, so that a founder at zero bandwidth stopping the reserved classes is visible
text_content:
Routed to: S17 (86ajgmk27)

Session 16 found that "a company built to run without them" is true of the operating system and false of the reserved classes (finding 15.1): every service, brief, close, check-in, and leads' review runs with every founder unreachable, and every change of the company's shape (a service period built or removed, a non-negotiable changed, a version, a principal admitted or removed, a pay parameter set) cannot; row 14 and row 205 read the first, and nothing in the assembled test reads the second, so a partners' review that has not taken a reserved-class decision in a quarter because a founder is at zero bandwidth is invisible to every readiness row. Session 17 decides whether the assembled test carries a row for the company's shape (the reserved classes' holds standing past a stated count of reviews, read from the partners' page) or a statement beside the test that the test reads the building only, and the team recommends the row, with its count as a reset parameter and no person named. This extends 86akh5un6 and 86akht3fx and does not repeat them. Normal.
